title: [GMCP 203.047.03] Integration: Documentation, examples, developer experience, release quality, and SLOs
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-047-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: Versioned operator, author, host, security, migration, troubleshooting and architecture documentation is executable and matches shipped behavior; examples cover every primitive and official extension from minimal to production. One-command setup and diagnostics pass usability studies, releases carry compatibility/SBOM/provenance evidence, and published availability, recovery, performance and support SLOs are measured with error-budget policy. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
